note: Both sets capture the core drivetrain values with faithful quotes and correct units, and both contain harmless duplicates (brake torque, gearbox ratio, rotor speed). Set B additionally captures the DOWEC turbine's 0.35 MW power loss with its rated-power and 6.25 MW aerodynamic-power conditions, a real fact from the text that Set A omits. Set B's only weakness is looser entity binding on three claims (generator efficiency, driveshaft damping constant, gearbox frictional losses attributed to the NREL 5-MW turbine rather than the component), but the attribute names the component so these are not misreadings. Neither set invents values.
